import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.utils.cpp_extension import load_inline

# Custom CUDA code for ReLU
relu_source = r"""
#include <torch/extension.h>
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cmath>

__global__ void custom_relu_kernel(const float* in, float* out, int size) {
    int idx = blockDim.x * blockIdx.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (idx < size) {
        out[idx] = fmaxf(in[idx], 0.0f);
    }
}

torch::Tensor custom_relu_cuda(torch::Tensor input) {
    auto output = torch::zeros_like(input);
    int size = input.numel();
    int threads = 256;
    int blocks = (size + threads - 1) / threads;

    custom_relu_kernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(input.data_ptr<float>(), output.data_ptr<float>(), size);
    return output;
}
"""

relu_cpp_source = "torch::Tensor custom_relu_cuda(torch::Tensor input);"

custom_ops = load_inline(
    name="custom_ops",
    cpp_sources=relu_cpp_source,
    cuda_sources=relu_source,
    functions=["custom_relu_cuda"],
    verbose=False
)

class CustomReLU(nn.Module):
    def forward(self, x):
        return custom_ops.custom_relu_cuda(x)

class ModelNew(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=1000):
        super(ModelNew, self).__init__()
        
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels=3, out_channels=96, kernel_size=11, stride=4, padding=2)
        self.relu1 = CustomReLU()
        self.maxpool1 = nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2)
        
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels=96, out_channels=256, kernel_size=5, padding=2)
        self.relu2 = CustomReLU()
        self.maxpool2 = nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2)
        
        self.conv3 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels=256, out_channels=384, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.relu3 = CustomReLU()
        
        self.conv4 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels=384, out_channels=384, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.relu4 = CustomReLU()
        
        self.conv5 = nn.Conv2d(in_channels=384, out_channels=256, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.relu5 = CustomReLU()
        self.maxpool3 = nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2)
        
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(in_features=256 * 6 * 6, out_features=4096)
        self.relu6 = CustomReLU()
        self.dropout1 = nn.Dropout(p=0.0)
        
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(in_features=4096, out_features=4096)
        self.relu7 = CustomReLU()
        self.dropout2 = nn.Dropout(p=0.0)
        
        self.fc3 = nn.Linear(in_features=4096, out_features=num_classes)
    
    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.conv1(x)
        x = self.relu1(x)
        x = self.maxpool1(x)
        
        x = self.conv2(x)
        x = self.relu2(x)
        x = self.maxpool2(x)
        
        x = self.conv3(x)
        x = self.relu3(x)
        
        x = self.conv4(x)
        x = self.relu4(x)
        
        x = self.conv5(x)
        x = self.relu5(x)
        x = self.maxpool3(x)
        
        x = torch.flatten(x, 1)
        
        x = self.fc1(x)
        x = self.relu6(x)
        x = self.dropout1(x)
        
        x = self.fc2(x)
        x = self.relu7(x)
        x = self.dropout2(x)
        
        x = self.fc3(x)
        
        return x
